queries.name: the ledger sums to zero after the replacement
queries.sql: select sum(case when entry_type = 'DEBIT' then -amount else amount end) from ledger_entries

queries.name: two different destination fingerprints on the transfers
queries.sql: select count(distinct destination_fingerprint) from gateway_events where event_type = 'TRANSFER'

queries.name: the private author draft is not loaded
queries.sql: select count(*) from reconciliation_notes where visibility = 'RESTRICTED_AUTHOR'
